_note: Traditional Nepali ukhan/tukka (folk sayings — public cultural heritage) with original explanations by the Patro editorial team (CC BY-SA 4.0). Drafted with AI assistance; review wording before publishing.

proverbs.meaningNe: जुन ठाउँमा जान्छौ त्यहीँको चालचलन अनुसार चल्नुपर्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Adapt to the customs of the place you are in.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

proverbs.meaningNe: आफ्नो कमजोरी लुकाउन अरू वस्तु वा परिस्थितिलाई दोष दिनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Blaming circumstances for one's own lack of skill.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: A bad workman blames his tools.

proverbs.meaningNe: झगडा वा कुनै काम एक पक्षले मात्र हुँदैन; दुवै पक्ष जिम्मेवार हुन्छन्।
proverbs.meaningEn: Both sides share responsibility for a quarrel or an outcome.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: It takes two to tango.

proverbs.meaningNe: धेरै जना जिम्मेवार हुँदा काम बिग्रन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: When too many people are in charge, the work suffers.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Too many cooks spoil the broth.

proverbs.meaningNe: शक्ति हुनेकै पक्षमा मानिसहरू लाग्छन्।
proverbs.meaningEn: People side with whoever holds power.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Might is right.

proverbs.meaningNe: गोप्य कुरा एक-दुई जनामा पुगेपछि सबैतिर फैलिन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: A secret shared soon becomes public.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Three may keep a secret if two of them are dead.

proverbs.text: आफ्नो आङको भैँसी देख्दैन, अर्काको आङको जुम्रा देख्छ
proverbs.meaningNe: आफ्नो ठूलो दोष नदेखी अरूको सानो दोष औँल्याउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Ignoring one's own big faults while pointing out others' tiny ones.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: The pot calling the kettle black.

proverbs.meaningNe: ठूलो हल्ला भए पनि परिणाम केही नहुनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Great fanfare with a disappointing result.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Much ado about nothing.

proverbs.meaningNe: कहिल्यै नपाइने कुराको आशा गरेर बस्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Longing for something forever out of reach.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Crying for the moon.

proverbs.meaningNe: कतैको पनि नहुनु; दुवैतिरबाट अलग पर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Belonging nowhere; rejected by both sides.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Neither fish nor fowl.

proverbs.meaningNe: एकपटक भनेको वा छोडेको कुरा फेरि स्वीकार्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To take back what one said or rejected.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To eat one's words.

proverbs.meaningNe: दोषमा संलग्न भएर पनि आफूलाई निर्दोष देखाउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Pretending to be innocent while being involved.

proverbs.meaningNe: जस्तो व्यवहार गर्ने मानिस हो, उसलाई त्यस्तै व्यवहार गर्नुपर्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Treat people the way they deserve.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Tit for tat.

proverbs.meaningNe: काम गर्नेभन्दा बाहिरबाट हेर्नेलाई बढी चिन्ता वा अप्ठ्यारो लाग्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: The onlooker frets more than the one doing the work.

proverbs.meaningNe: आफ्नो हित मात्र हेर्ने, आफूपछि जे भए पनि वास्ता नगर्ने स्वभाव।
proverbs.meaningEn: Caring only about oneself, not what happens after.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: After me, the deluge.

proverbs.text: कुकुरको पुच्छर बाह्र वर्ष ढुङ्ग्रामा राखे पनि बाङ्गाको बाङ्गै
proverbs.meaningNe: जन्मजात खराब स्वभाव जति प्रयास गरे पनि सुध्रिँदैन।
proverbs.meaningEn: A bad nature does not change, whatever you try.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: A leopard cannot change its spots.

proverbs.meaningNe: बाहिर मीठो बोल्ने तर भित्र खराब नियत राख्ने।
proverbs.meaningEn: Sweet words outside, harmful intent inside.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: A wolf in sheep's clothing.

proverbs.meaningNe: भविष्यमा सफल हुनेका लक्षण सानैदेखि देखिन्छन्।
proverbs.meaningEn: Signs of future success show early.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Coming events cast their shadows before.

proverbs.meaningNe: मूल्य नबुझ्ने व्यक्तिको हातमा बहुमूल्य वस्तु पर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: A valuable thing in the hands of someone who can't appreciate it.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Pearls before swine.

proverbs.meaningNe: सबै अयोग्य भएका ठाउँमा थोरै जान्ने पनि ठूलो मानिन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Among the incapable, the slightly capable is king.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: In the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king.

proverbs.text: जुन थालमा खायो उसैमा प्वाल पार्नु
proverbs.meaningNe: गुन लगाउनेकै अहित गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To harm the one who helped you.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To bite the hand that feeds you.

proverbs.meaningNe: समस्या आइसकेपछि मात्र तयारी गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Preparing only after trouble has arrived.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Locking the stable door after the horse has bolted.

proverbs.meaningNe: समस्या एकातिर, समाधान अर्कैतिर खोज्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Looking for the remedy in the wrong place.

proverbs.meaningNe: अति हतार गरेर आफैँलाई हानि पुर्‍याउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Harming oneself through impatience.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Haste makes waste.

proverbs.meaningNe: हैसियतभन्दा ठूलो कुरा गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Talking far beyond one's standing.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Big talk from a small mouth.

proverbs.meaningNe: सही र गलत छुट्याएर न्याय गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Fair judgement that separates right from wrong.

proverbs.meaningNe: आफ्नै कामले आफैँलाई हानि गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To harm oneself by one's own action.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To shoot oneself in the foot.

proverbs.meaningNe: धेरै समय लगाएर पनि थोरै प्रगति हुनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Very slow progress despite much time.

proverbs.meaningNe: एउटै प्रयासले दुई काम पूरा गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Achieving two things with one effort.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To kill two birds with one stone.

proverbs.meaningNe: किताबभन्दा भोगाइले बढी सिकाउँछ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Experience teaches more than books.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Experience is the best teacher.

proverbs.meaningNe: दुवै पक्षलाई खुसी पार्न खोजी अनिश्चित हुनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: Trying to keep a foot in both camps.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To sit on the fence.

proverbs.text: हात्तीका देखाउने दाँत अर्कै, चपाउने दाँत अर्कै
proverbs.meaningNe: भनाइ र गराइ फरक हुनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: What is shown differs from what is done.

proverbs.meaningNe: पढ्न नजान्ने; निरक्षर।
proverbs.meaningEn: Completely unable to read.

proverbs.meaningNe: संयोगले दुई घटना एकैसाथ पर्दा निर्दोषमाथि शङ्का पर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: A coincidence that makes someone look guilty.

proverbs.meaningNe: आधा ज्ञान खतरनाक हुन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Half-knowledge is dangerous.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: A little learning is a dangerous thing.

proverbs.text: एकले थुकी सुकी, सयले थुकी नदी
proverbs.meaningNe: एक्लैले केही हुँदैन, धेरै मिले ठूलो काम हुन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Alone we achieve little; together, a lot.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Unity is strength.

proverbs.meaningNe: चाहना भएकालाई सानो बाधाले रोक्न सक्दैन।
proverbs.meaningEn: A small obstacle doesn't stop someone determined.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Where there's a will, there's a way.

proverbs.text: सस्तो रोयो बारम्बार, महँगो रोयो एकबार
proverbs.meaningNe: सस्तो तर कमसल वस्तुले पटकपटक दुःख दिन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Cheap goods make you regret again and again.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Buy cheap, buy twice.

proverbs.meaningNe: आफू असल भए संसार पनि असल देखिन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: If you are good, the world is good to you.

proverbs.meaningNe: इच्छाशक्ति भए बाटो भेटिन्छ।
proverbs.meaningEn: Determination finds a way.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Where there's a will, there's a way.

proverbs.meaningNe: केही नहुनुभन्दा कमजोर भए पनि हुनु राम्रो।
proverbs.meaningEn: Something is better than nothing.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Half a loaf is better than none.

proverbs.meaningNe: कसैले पनि आफ्नो कुरालाई नराम्रो भन्दैन।
proverbs.meaningEn: No one calls their own thing bad.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: Every cook praises his own broth.

proverbs.text: एक कानले सुन्ने अर्को कानले उडाउने
proverbs.meaningNe: सुनेर पनि वास्ता नगर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To hear but pay no attention.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: In one ear and out the other.

proverbs.meaningNe: धेरै ठूलो भिन्नता।
proverbs.meaningEn: A world of difference.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: As different as chalk and cheese.

proverbs.meaningNe: अति हैरान वा थकित हुनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To be utterly exhausted or fed up.

proverbs.meaningNe: केही नसुनेझैँ बेवास्ता गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To deliberately ignore.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To turn a deaf ear.

proverbs.meaningNe: पूरा शक्ति लगाई कसैको पछि लाग्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To pursue relentlessly.

proverbs.meaningNe: पूरा आत्मविश्वासका साथ भन्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To say with full confidence.

proverbs.meaningNe: अत्यन्त प्यारो व्यक्ति।
proverbs.meaningEn: A dearly loved person.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: The apple of one's eye.

proverbs.meaningNe: धोका दिनु; झुक्याउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To deceive, to hoodwink.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To pull the wool over someone's eyes.

proverbs.meaningNe: विद्रोह गर्नु वा विरोधमा उत्रनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To rise up in revolt.

proverbs.meaningNe: जसोतसो जीविका चलाउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To eke out a living.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To make ends meet.

proverbs.meaningNe: अत्यन्त लज्जित हुनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To be deeply ashamed.

proverbs.meaningNe: लाजले कसैको सामना गर्न नसक्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To hide one's face in shame.

proverbs.meaningNe: कुनै काम सुरु गर्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To start on a task.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To set one's hand to something.

proverbs.meaningNe: कसैको भावनामा चोट पुर्‍याउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To hurt someone's feelings.

proverbs.meaningNe: कुनै वस्तु पाउन मन गर्नु वा नजर गाड्नु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To covet, to set one's eyes on.

proverbs.meaningNe: दुःखीलाई झन् दुःख दिनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To make someone's pain worse.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To rub salt in the wound.

proverbs.meaningNe: अरूको प्रगतिमा बाधा पुर्‍याउनु।
proverbs.meaningEn: To hold someone back out of envy.
proverbs.englishEquivalent: To pull someone down.

proverbs.meaningNe: वास्ता नहुनु; जे भए होस्।
proverbs.meaningEn: Who cares; let it go to ruin.
